description: epanet2toolkit exposes EPANET 2.2 programmer functions in R for standard or customised hydraulic simulations, with CRAN installation and documented examples. This resource is provided by bradleyjeck (repository owner). Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Limitation: The wrapper supports much of EPANET 2.2 functionality, not a claim of every newer engine feature. For simulation, it can support model preparation or execution.
